title: Auto-correct invoice overruns and scheduled refund operations
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Enterprise customers are reporting invoice overruns during mid-cycle capacity usage bursts and post-hoc contract adjustments. Current manual process for retroactive credits and scheduled refunds is error-prone, slow, and lacks a reliable audit trail. Scope: build an automated backfill and scheduled refund service for invoices, with safeguards for negative balances, reserved capacity credits, and legal auditability. This ticket covers product requirements, acceptance criteria, UX hooks in Console, API contract for refunds, and rollout strategy with customer opt-in/out.
acceptance_criteria: System can detect invoice overruns (over-usage) and create recommended credit adjustments with line-item justification
Admin can approve or auto-apply refunds on a scheduled cadence (daily/weekly) via Console and API
All backfills produce immutable ledger entries and referenceable audit IDs included on customer invoices
Negative-balance safeguard prevents automated credits that would create negative customer balances unless explicitly allowed by contract
End-to-end telemetry shows time to detect -> credit creation -> refund completion and is surfaced in Console billing dashboard
decisions: We will implement a two-step flow: detection -> proposed credit -> auto-apply policy (configurable per-customer)
Default auto-apply policy for P0/P1 enterprise customers will be 'manual approval' until first successful pilot
Ledger will use a new immutable 'adjustment' record with cross-reference to original invoice and triggering event
Refunds will be issued via payments provider only after ledger entry is committed to ensure accounting parity
technical_notes: ENG needs to add a backfill queue with idempotency keys to avoid double credits during retries
Mapping required between usage event ids from metering pipeline and billing invoice line ids
Reserved capacity credits must be constrained by contract SKU mapping to avoid over-crediting shared pools
Rate-limit API for scheduled refunds to 50 operations/minute to stay within payments provider limits
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (pilot): Run detection and 'proposed credits' in read-only mode for 3 enterprise customers (2 weeks)
Phase 1: Enable manual-approval flow via Console for billing admins (4 weeks)
Phase 2: Offer opt-in auto-apply policy and run 1-month live pilot with monitoring and rollback hooks (4 weeks)
Phase 3: GA release and include in billing-2025.03 with release notes and customer communications
